newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine's Lazarenko offers resignation - Interfax.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine's Lazarenko offers resignation - Interfax.

text.p: Ukrainian Prime Minister Pavlo Lazarenko has offered his resignation to President Leonid Kuchma, who plans to accept it, Interfax-Ukraine news agency quoted a source close to Lazarenko as saying.
Kuchma has ordered a "corresponding document," or decree accepting Lazarenko's resignation, be prepared and signed early on Wednesday, Interfax-Ukraine quoted the source as saying.
Kuchma's office could not confirm Lazarenko had offered his resignation and said no decree had been issued on the subject so far.
Aides to Lazarenko could not immediately be contacted for comment, but one told Reuters earlier that Kuchma was likely to confirm his removal from office this week.
Lazarenko was taken to a government hospital last month and replaced "for the time of his illness" by his deputy Vasyl Durdynets, but there were varying accounts of what was wrong with him.
Lazarenko's admission to hospital on June 19 was widely seen as a ploy and a sign that Kuchma planned to remove him from power.
